sentences.en: He disclosed to me that he had been in prison.
sentences.zh: 他向我透露他曾坐过牢。

sentences.en: This researcher does not disclose the source of his funding.
sentences.zh: 这位研究人员没有透露其资金来源。

sentences.en: The criminal disclosed all the facts of the case eventually.
sentences.zh: 那个罪犯最终供出了所有案情的细节。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dis（不）+close（关闭）→不关闭→透露
